facts.text: Grand Hyatt Denver is in downtown Denver, within easy reach of 16th Street, Union Station, Coors Field and Ball Arena.
facts.excerpt: At Grand Hyatt Denver, some of the city’s best experiences are within easy reach, from 16th Street and Union Station to Coors Field and Ball Arena.

facts.text: Guestrooms offer city or Rocky Mountain views.
facts.excerpt: Comfortable guestrooms offer city or Rocky Mountain views

facts.text: The hotel has a rooftop jogging track and a combined tennis and pickleball court.
facts.excerpt: unique amenities include a rooftop jogging track and combined tennis/pickleball court, heated indoor pool and 24-hour fitness center

facts.text: The hotel has a heated indoor pool and a 24-hour fitness center.
facts.excerpt: unique amenities include a rooftop jogging track and combined tennis/pickleball court, heated indoor pool and 24-hour fitness center

facts.text: The redesigned lobby has a fireplace and furnishings by RH.
facts.excerpt: settle in by the fire in our redesigned lobby featuring furnishings by RH

facts.text: The Pinnacle Club, an event venue 38 floors above the city, has panoramic downtown and Rocky Mountain views.
facts.excerpt: the Pinnacle Club, Denver’s highest indoor event venue, rises 38 floors above the city with panoramic downtown and Rocky Mountain views

facts.text: Honey from the hotel's rooftop beehives is used in cocktails and dishes at Courier and Fireside.
facts.excerpt: The honey harvested is now featured in handcrafted cocktails and dishes at Courier and Fireside.

facts.text: courier. kitchen & bar is a newsroom-inspired restaurant nodding to the building's history as the former home of one of Denver's oldest newspapers.
facts.excerpt: courier. kitchen & bar is a contemporary, newsroom-inspired restaurant that nods to the building’s history as the former home of one of Denver’s oldest newspapers

facts.text: Fireside | The Bar in the lobby has linear stacked fireplaces and live music from local artists on select nights.
facts.excerpt: enjoy live music from local artists on select nights

facts.text: The High Floor King room on the upper floors offers panoramic downtown Denver and Rocky Mountain views and furnishings by RH.
facts.excerpt: Located on the hotel's upper floors, the newly renovated High Floor King room offers panoramic downtown Denver and Rocky Mountain views, Furnishings by RH

facts.text: The Executive Suite has Rocky Mountain and city views, a king bedroom, sleeper sofa and dining table.
facts.excerpt: Soak in Rocky Mountain and city views from this downtown executive suite, featuring a king bedroom, large bathroom, sleeper sofa and dining table.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has Denver skyline views, dining for four and a bath with soaking tub and walk-in shower.
facts.excerpt: suite with Denver skyline views, plush seating, dining for four, extended bath with soaking tub, walk-in shower, and half bath

facts.text: Families can rent board games and use the rooftop tennis and pickleball court.
facts.excerpt: From board game rentals to tennis and pickleball at our rooftop court, the whole family can enjoy outdoor adventures and cozy nights in.

facts.text: Complimentary tennis rackets and pickleball paddles are available at the front desk.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary tennis rackets and pickleball paddles are available at the front desk

facts.text: Grand Hyatt Denver is a dog-friendly hotel that greets dogs with treats.
facts.excerpt: Grand Hyatt Denver is a dog-friendly hotel, and we’ll warmly greet your pup with treats

facts.text: The hotel is cash-free and accepts only cards and other contactless payment.
facts.excerpt: this hotel only accepts credit cards, debit cards and, where applicable, other contactless forms of payment. It is a cash-free environment.

facts.text: Denver International Airport is 25 miles from the hotel.
The hotel calls its accommodations among the metro area's most spacious.
facts.excerpt: retreat to some of the metro area’s most spacious and comfortable hotel accommodations
